successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Dar al-Kuti under Sanussi: 'centre and northwest of present-day Central African Republic', later 'much of modern CAR' (the page gives no outline; four CAR prefectures stand for it)

ledger.x: 17 December 1912: the end per the page's body; the infobox gives 1830-1911 with "Final surrender of Kamun, Senussi's son".

wars.name: Wadai destruction of Chá
wars.outcome: "In October 1894, Wadai's aguid Cherfeddine destroyed" Chá; Sanussi then founded N'Délé.

wars.name: French conquest of Dar al-Kuti
wars.outcome: 28 August 1897: Sanussi and Émile Gentil signed a treaty of trade and alliance (revised 18 February 1903 and 26 January 1908) establishing a French protectorate; after his death on 12 January 1911 France took most of the territory directly; Ouanda Djallé fell…

certainty.note: No outline; 'much of modern CAR' is undated and the prefectures are a guess.
